For a 50-person Indian company, I’d compare the strongest practical options as a managed TMC/platform rather than looking for a fixed “subscription price.” Most providers quote after seeing annual travel volume.

Option	Fee / total-cost structure	Cancellation / exclusions	Support	Best fit
FCM Travel India	Custom TMC/transaction quote + actual airfare/hotel. Corporate hotel programme advertises savings of up to 38%+. 
FCM Travel
	Supplier/fare rules apply. FCM says cancellation charges can reach 100%, plus amendment/reissue fees. Refunds wait on supplier funds. 
FCM Travel
	24/7, dedicated account management, disruption/risk support. 
FCM Travel
+1
	Companies wanting full-service managed travel
Amex GBT + Business Travel Account	Custom TMC fees + travel spend. BTA consolidates air spend into one bill; payment period can extend to 51 days. 
American Express
	Air/hotel supplier fare rules; insurance has policy exclusions/limits. BTA is primarily a payment/control layer, so confirm the TMC bundled with it. 
American Express
	24/7 Global Assist; central reconciliation/reporting. 
American Express
	Finance teams prioritising central billing + control
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Service fee mutually agreed + travel price/GST; 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply. 
MakeMyTrip
	Airline/hotel rules govern refunds; MMT convenience fee is non-refundable. 30-day termination notice where no other term is specified. 
MakeMyTrip
+1
	Corporate platform + support; less bespoke than a traditional TMC	SMEs wanting simpler/self-service booking
What I’d demand in the quote

Ask each for a 12-month all-in TCO, separating: booking fees, amendments, cancellations, GST, hotel mark-ups, payment fees, after-hours support, implementation, credit/payment terms and refund timelines.

Important: don't treat “corporate discount” as the net saving. Ask for the same 20–30 representative routes/hotels priced simultaneously and compare final payable amounts.

For Chennai delivery under ₹7,000, I’d shortlist:

GIVA — strong gifting/packaging; silver sets around ₹2,500–₹6,500. Offers a 15-day return on eligible products. 
GIVA Jewellery

Silver Store Chennai — good if you want local Chennai delivery; 925 pieces roughly ₹1,000–₹6,800, with same-day delivery available on some items. 
Silver Store Chennai
+1

Ithara Jewels — good gifting range, including pieces under ₹3,000 and ₹5,000; offers a 7-day return and 6-month warranty. 
Ithara Jewels

Check total cost: product + GST + delivery/gift-box charges. Also verify 925 hallmark, return window, return shipping deduction, personalised-item exclusions, and delivery date to the Chennai pincode.
